role: Reviewed intent. Human-edited. Lists every snow texture to generate.

conventions.evidence: Verified against MSR788_Rifle: the muzzle attachment offset Y=0.4968 equals the mesh maximum Y=0.4966, the scope attachment sits at Z=+0.0491 above the bore at Z=+0.0308, and a textured side render is upright only with +Z up and V used directly.
conventions.warning: Y=length holds across every vanilla firearm mesh sampled, but no cheap geometric test reliably recovers the up SIGN: 'up area exceeds down area' fails on 1911_Pistol and D_E_Pistol, and 'centroid below mid-height' fails on every rifle. Each asset therefore carries an explicit axis and must be confirmed by looking at a render before its recipe is frozen.
conventions.stageProgression: noiseBase and edgeSoftness are IDENTICAL across the stages of one weapon, on purpose. The mask keeps one noise field and only lowers the threshold, so each stage's snow is a superset of the previous stage's. Re-rolling the field per stage would make snow appear in different places between stages, which reads in game as snow teleporting when a threshold is crossed. Only targetUpCoverage, flankCoverage and flankMaxAlpha vary.
